scopeLabel: All nine admitted main-paper pages were actually read as text and images. This source-scoped extraction covers the typical PbS synthesis, seven ligand exchanges, thermal and XRR film branches, characterization, reported comparisons and explicitly separate model interpretations. SI and cited upstream procedures are not admitted or imported. Unreported settings and exact physical batch joins remain unknown.

availability.morphology_illustration: Measured source figures and reported specimen facts are retained. Optional bulk PbS reference selection is restricted to the named XRD context.

bindings.caption: Describe the source effective-medium model. Hasselman-Johnson effective-medium model of NC cores in a ligand matrix, including interface thermal conductance, fits the OA diameter trend. This records the authors model; no new calculation or unprovided SI implementation is claimed. Qualified action illustration; no unreported apparatus dimensions, atmosphere, time, measured atomic geometry or experimental trace is implied.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
